Definition: Betsai, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Betsai means "conqueror." He was a chief of the returning exiles in the time of Ezra. It turns up in Ezra 2:17, Nehemiah 7:23 and Nehemiah 10:18.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God kept Betsai in the record on purpose, and that is reason enough to know it.
